name: Ricardo Alberto Gomez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He originally trained as a panel beater in Buenos Aires, but a chance encounter at a local racing event ignited a passion for the artistry of motorsport paintwork. He spent years honing his skills, eventually securing a position with a small racing team, where he quickly earned a reputation for his meticulous attention to detail and ability to create stunning, durable paint finishes. He joined VW Racing Brasil seeking a bigger challenge and the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. Ricardo is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection and his deep understanding of how paint affects both the aesthetics and performance of a race car. He is a firm believer that a well-executed paint job is not just about looks; it's about contributing to the overall efficiency and aerodynamic profile of the vehicle. 

Ricardo is a driven individual, always seeking new techniques and materials to improve his craft. He has a keen eye for color and design, and he works closely with the aerodynamicists to ensure that the paint scheme complements the car's overall performance. His ability to troubleshoot issues with paint adhesion and application is unmatched, making him an invaluable asset to the team. He is also fiercely independent, preferring to work autonomously and trusting his own judgment above all else. His calm demeanor under pressure makes him a stabilizing force in the high-stress environment of the race shop.

physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man with strong hands and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always wears a spotless white lab coat, even when mixing paints.
Has a lucky paintbrush that he uses for all final clear coats.
Listens to tango music while working to maintain focus.
